## Research Interests

The evolution of cooperation \| Behavioural economics \| Cultural evolution \| Open science \| Evolution and human behaviour \| Cross-cultural psychology \| Political and moral psychology

## Research Skills

-   Programming (R, Python, Javascript)
-   Survey creation with *Qualtrics*
-   Statistical modelling with *brms*, *lavaan*, and *Stan*
-   Reproducible analytic pipelines with *targets*
-   Behavioural economic games with *oTree*
-   Open science (e.g. preregistration)
-   Project version control with *Git* and *GitHub*
